user.title: Create a wallet
user.description: Configure a wallet with market valors valued via Yahoo Finance.

data.base_currency: Base currency (wallet total is shown in this currency)
data.rebalance_precision: Rebalance precision (decimal places for rebalance units: 0 = whole units only, 1-3 = fractional units allowed)
data.invested_amount: Invested amount (optional, in the base currency; enables profit tracking)
data.cash_amount: Free cash (optional, in the base currency; tracked separately, set empty to disable)

valor.title: Add a valor
valor.description: Add a market valor to this wallet. Use Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. AAPL, VWAGY, BTC-USD, or an ETF like VWCE.DE.

data.target_share: Target share (%; optional — percent of the wallet this valor should hold; enables the deviation sensor)
data.add_another: Add another valor after this one

error.invalid_symbol: Please enter a valid Yahoo Finance symbol.
error.symbol_exists: This symbol is already in the wallet.
error.target_sum_exceeded: The sum of target shares would exceed 100%.

menu_options.settings: Edit wallet settings (name, currency, interval, invested amount, free cash)

data.rebalance_precision: Rebalance precision (decimal places for rebalance units: 0 = whole units only, 1-3 = fractional units allowed)
data.invested_amount: Invested amount (optional, in the base currency; set empty to disable profit tracking)
data.cash_amount: Free cash (optional, in the base currency; tracked separately, set empty to disable)

data.target_share: Target share (%; optional — percent of the wallet this valor should hold)

trade.title: Buy or sell a valor
trade.description: Free cash: {cash}. The transaction value is subtracted from (buy) or added to (sell) the free cash.

data.unit_price: Unit price (optional; empty = latest live quote)

data.target_share: Target share (%; clear to remove the target)

error.invalid_symbol: Please enter a valid Yahoo Finance symbol.
error.symbol_exists: This symbol is already in the wallet.
error.target_sum_exceeded: The sum of target shares would exceed 100%.
error.invested_negative: The withdrawal would make the invested amount negative.
error.cash_negative: The withdrawal would make the free cash negative.
error.quantity_too_small: The quantity rounds to zero at the wallet's rebalance precision.
error.not_enough_units: Not enough units held to sell this quantity.
error.unit_price_required: No live quote is available; enter the unit price.

abort.no_valors: The wallet has no valors yet.

refresh.name: Refresh wallet
refresh.description: Force an immediate price update for the selected wallet(s).

adjust_invested.name: Adjust invested amount
adjust_invested.description: Update the invested amount of a wallet via a deposit (add), a withdrawal (subtract) or by setting an exact value. The change is stored in the wallet configuration.

entity.name: Wallet
entity.description: Any sensor of the wallet whose invested amount should be changed.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: deposit: add the amount, withdraw: subtract it, set: replace the value.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the wallet's base currency (must be non-negative).

adjust_cash.name: Adjust free cash
adjust_cash.description: Update the tracked free cash of a wallet via a deposit (add), a withdrawal (subtract) or by setting an exact value. The change is stored in the wallet configuration.

entity.name: Wallet
entity.description: Any sensor of the wallet whose free cash should be changed.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: deposit: add the amount, withdraw: subtract it, set: replace the value.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the wallet's base currency (must be non-negative).

trade.name: Trade valor
trade.description: Buy or sell a quantity of a valor. The transaction value (quantity × unit price) is subtracted from (buy) or added to (sell) the tracked free cash. Without an explicit unit price the latest live quote is used.

entity.name: Wallet
entity.description: Any sensor of the wallet the trade belongs to.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: buy: add units and subtract the value from free cash, sell: remove units and add the value to free cash.

symbol.name: Symbol
symbol.description: Yahoo Finance symbol of the valor to trade (must already be in the wallet).

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Units to buy or sell; rounded to the wallet's rebalance precision.

unit_price.name: Unit price (optional)
unit_price.description: Price per unit in the wallet's base currency; when omitted the latest live quote is used.
